bug:M09.title: Bug cards lacked numbered repro steps, used cryptic setup shorthand and did not embed screenshots

bug:M10.title: Over-rated a bug only reachable by bypassing the UI

bug:M11.title: Started engineering an artificial trigger without asking

bug:M12.title: False alarm: count parser read chart labels as tile values

bug:M13.title: False alarm avoided: CTA probe clicked a hidden duplicate tab during load

bug:M14.title: QA skill lacked classic techniques and non-functional testing until asked

bug:M15.title: Count tile not filtered when the count is 0 (fix only covered counts above 0)

bug:M16.title: 'Open Secrets' opened a blank Settings page

bug:M18.title: Blank page with a divider line for 12+ s on first open after idle

bug:M19.title: Selecting a live worker doesn't highlight its node in the graph

bug:M20.title: Graph flickers (seen in a screen recording)

bug:M21.title: A View-menu toggle switches on and persists but has no visible effect; it was marked as working

bug:M22.title: Filed 'open tab doesn't refresh after a background sync' as a bug; owner says not valid

bug:M25.title: Summary panel truncation not reported although the same defect was filed for a sibling panel

bug:M27.title: Filed a CLI defaulting to prod unless an env var selects stage as a bug; owner says expected

bug:M28.title: Summary panel rows cut at the panel edge with no ellipsis in dark mode; dark mode was only contrast-scanned on one view

bug:M29.title: Several View-menu options shown in the prototype were missing from the build; not reported

bug:M30.title: One panel lists items as Failing that two other views show as Passing

bug:M31.title: Items with 0 tests labelled 'Not verified yet' instead of 'No test yet'

bug:M33.title: A report ignores the data its header says it covers

bug:M34.title: Raw ids, enums and escaped markdown shown in a detail panel

cause:baseline-gap.text: the expectation was not in the checklist (new or unread requirement)

cause:instrument-gap.text: the tool could not observe it (e.g. DOM vs pixels)

cause:judgement.text: it was seen but wrongly dismissed or mis-rated

cause:oracle-gap.text: it was exercised but nothing judged it wrong

cause:probe-error.text: the test script measured the wrong thing

check:api-contract.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:api-contract.text: API: status codes per error class, error body format, schema/types, limits = UI, idempotency/double submit, pagination/sort/filter edges

check:authz-idor.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:authz-idor.text: Another user/org can't read or change entities by ID; role limits enforced server-side

check:automation-candidates.text: List cases to automate as regression tests and generate them where the team's tooling allows (e.g. a test-generation CLI)

check:boundary-values.text: BVA on every length/number/count/time input: testgen.py bva → min-1, min, min+1, max-1, max, max+1, empty, multi-byte at the boundary; in UI, API and after reload

check:bug-by-bug-rerun.text: After the last deploy, re-run every bug's original steps; record verified-on-build per bug

check:bug-card-complete.text: Before publishing: every bug card has preconditions, numbered steps, expected, actual and embedded screenshots; setups have descriptive names, no shorthand; run prereport.py check

check:causality.text: Every failure names the real failed step and what is missing, and offers the fix

check:claims.text: Every sentence of helper/banner/empty-state copy is observably true

check:compat-matrix.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:compat-matrix.text: Supported browsers and viewports tested, or recorded as out of scope with reason

check:competency-audit.text: At the start of every engagement walk references/competencies.md; every area planned or N/A with reason; when building or changing the skill, audit it against the competency list

check:consistency.text: Every count/state/name shown in 2+ places (headline, tiles, badges, list, API) matches

check:container-rerun-semantics.text: For every re-run/run-this-step inside a block: note which instruction ids the request targets, compute the expected outcome from the container's current condition, and only file what differs from that (e.g. stale display)

check:control-flow-composition-matrix.text: Build the container x child-kind matrix (authored If/Else-If/Else/While x natural if-else, wait-until, scroll-until, click-until, nested if) with testgen.py pairwise and run each cell with a deterministic oracle

check:cross-surface.text: Create in CLI/API, view in UI and vice versa; open page notices changes made elsewhere

check:crud-matrix.text: CRUD × surface (UI/API/CLI) for every entity: possible, correct, reflected everywhere, survives reload, permission-checked

check:dark-contrast.text: contrast_scan.js on every view/drawer/dialog in dark and light; eyeball graphs, toggles, avatars

check:decision-table.text: Decision table for every outcome that depends on combined conditions (e.g. can Start be pressed): one expected result per column

check:deploy-verified.text: Before judging a fix: PR merged, deploy run's failing step inspected, build live

check:equivalence-classes.text: EP: one representative per valid class and one test per invalid reason (wrong type/format/range, empty, forbidden)

check:error-guessing.text: Error guessing from kb.py misses and this product's bug history

check:every-cta-destination.text: cta_destinations.js on every state with CTAs (empty, failed, warnings, Needs Attention, toasts, drawers): no BLANK or MISMATCH landing

check:evidence-matches-state.text: Before attaching evidence: confirm the screenshot's state matches the steps (zoom %, width, theme) and that every quoted string is visible in it

check:frame-diff-flicker.text: flicker_scan.js on the region while data refreshes (positive control first); ask for the action/timing shown in any recording

check:hidden-options-on.text: For every view/display toggle: measure the affected elements (labels, rows, lines) off vs on; the label's promise ('on every line') sets the expected count

check:i18n-time.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:i18n-time.text: Time zones, midnight crossings, date/number formats, long and non-Latin strings

check:keyboard-a11y.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:keyboard-a11y.text: Keyboard only: every action reachable, visible focus, logical order, Escape closes dialogs, no traps; screen-reader names; zoom 200%

check:labeled-chip-centering.text: For every new chip/pill/badge label: screenshot at 100% zoom; assert text optically centered (equal padding top/bottom); if a twin surface exists (two views showing the same label), diff both.

check:legacy-data.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:legacy-data.text: Data created before the change (old runs, notes, states) still displays and works

check:linked-views-and-thread.text: Re-read the dev/PM thread at every resume and add new expectations; select each entity and check every linked view follows

check:loading-frames.text: loading_sweep.js: frames every 0.5 s for tab click, direct URL, reload, first open after ~15 min idle, sub-tabs, drawers, fast+throttled; look at blank frames

check:original-steps-first.text: Re-run original steps; ask before forcing a trigger; use the Not reproduced status

check:pairwise-settings.text: testgen.py pairwise over the feature's parameters (policy, concurrency, sign-in, tunnel, actor, entry…) + known risky full combinations

check:per-container-menus.text: Open the / (or action) menu inside EVERY container type at least once and diff its entries against the expected per-container list

check:perf-measured.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:perf-measured.text: Time main API calls (p50/p95 over 10-20 requests), page-to-content, large data, repeated actions, long-open pages

check:permission.text: Repeat key flows as another member and as a UI-only user without the creator's setup

check:prereport-gate.text: Record every bug in ./qa-bugs/<feature>.json and run prereport.py check <feature>; nothing is reported or published until it passes

check:proto-control-diff.text: Extract each prototype menu/toolbar/strip option list (from its source when possible), diff with the build's, and cite the decision for every intentional removal

check:rawness.text: No raw codes, enums, CLI flags, placeholders or backend error text reach the user

check:reachability.text: For every bug state the user path; if it needs API/crafted request/race, mark it and lower severity

check:reachability-scroll.text: For any 'cut off / unreachable' claim: list scrollable ancestors (overflow auto/scroll with scrollWidth > clientWidth), scroll each, and click the control

check:read-pr-gating.text: List the feature's PRs; grep their diffs for the gating of every option/menu under test and cite the line when classifying a missing option

check:recovery.text: A late partial failure (one worker, one slot, an outage) doesn't erase or misdescribe completed work

check:reference-parity-first.text: Before filing any target-specific or parity bug, reproduce the same steps on the reference target/env and record its result next to the bug; if identical, classify as shared behaviour or by design

check:release-recommendation.text: Go / No-go / Go-with-conditions against exit criteria, with coverage line and open risks

check:reliability.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:reliability.text: Refresh/back/close mid-action, network drop and return, retries, timeouts, double submit

check:round-trip.text: Every saved field at 1, limit, limit+1 is read back whole via UI and API after reload

check:scenarios.text: Use-case scenarios end to end: main, alternative and exception flows with real data

check:scope-confirm.text: Before filing a staleness bug: find the requirement or on-screen promise of live updates; without one, log it as a question

check:secrets-hygiene.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:secrets-hygiene.text: Secrets never in URLs, page source, logs, evidence, screenshots or activity; masked in UI

check:sentinel-triaged.text: Run sentinel_start.js at the start of every session and label states; before sign-off, every group in sentinel_report.js is triaged: bug filed (with state/page), known bug id, or expected with reason

check:shared-env-contention.text: When a resource is unavailable or locked: look for other users' artifacts (new records, sessions), wait one full release window, retry, and note the shared-env caveat on the bug

check:sibling-sweep.text: For each layout bug filed, enumerate all panels/lists/cards of the same kind and record pass/fail for each in the bug

check:smoke-first.text: Smoke test the main job end to end before deep testing; stop and report if it fails

check:state-transitions.text: testgen.py states: every valid transition, critical 2-step paths, and every invalid event blocked in UI and refused by API; UI shown in and during each state

check:state-truth.text: UI state (badge, stepper, banner) matches backend session + job log at every lifecycle state

check:syntax-malformed.text: Syntax/format: each valid form once, then missing/extra/wrong-delimiter/case/whitespace/unicode look-alike/injection-shaped inputs

check:test-plan.text: Plan from references/competencies.md: scope/out-of-scope, risks, entry+exit criteria, environments, test data; every competency area applicable or N/A with reason

check:theme-full-sweep.text: In dark AND light: open every panel/drawer/summary/menu and each card type; screenshot each; flag text cut without ellipsis, clipped descenders and low contrast

check:verify-probe.text: Re-check every surprising input result with real keyboard typing; never click by coordinates in a live session

check:xss-injection.note: Not required by the user (18 Nov): run only when explicitly asked
check:xss-injection.text: XSS/injection-shaped strings in every text field render as text everywhere they appear (lists, drawers, activity, exports)

lesson:a-behaviour-on-one-target-is-only.text: A behaviour on one target is only a parity bug if the reference target differs; before filing, run the same steps on the reference (web, stage or prod) and confirm what the counter or state model counts

lesson:a-bug-card-is-for-someone-who-was.text: A bug card is for someone who was not there: numbered steps from a named setup, expected vs actual, ids, and the screenshots embedded in the published report

lesson:a-button-s-label-is-a-promise-abo.text: A button's label is a promise about where it goes; untested destinations hide broken links

lesson:a-control-flow-feature-must-be-te.text: A control-flow feature must be tested as a composition matrix: every container (If, Else-If, Else, While) x every child kind the product can produce, including AI-derived conditionals and until-loops (wait/scroll/click-until) and nested conditionals, not only the slash commands

lesson:a-display-option-is-verified-by-t.text: A display option is verified by the change it makes on screen, not by its checkmark or persistence: count the affected elements with it off and on, and compare with what the label promises

lesson:a-new-labeled-chip-pill-is-a-layo.text: A new labeled chip/pill is a layout surface: check vertical centering and padding symmetry in the shipped UI (light and dark), and compare both views when two of them render the same label.

lesson:a-prototype-is-a-list-of-controls.text: A prototype is a list of controls: diff every option in every menu, toolbar and strip against the build, item by item, and report each missing one unless a decision (thread/PR) removed it

lesson:a-theme-pass-is-a-full-pass-every.text: A theme pass is a full pass: every panel, drawer and card type is re-opened in the other theme and judged for clipping and truncation too, not just contrast on the main view

lesson:auto-refresh-of-an-open-page-afte.text: Auto-refresh of an open page after background work is a product choice, not a defect, unless the spec or UI copy promises live updates; record it as an observation and ask

lesson:before-calling-something-unreacha.text: Before calling something unreachable, scroll every scrollable ancestor (not just the window) and try to reach it with a real action

lesson:before-filing-a-claim-gap-plan-ga.text: Before filing a claim-gap, plan-gap or raw-value bug, confirm the surface is in the feature's scope and the value isn't intended; a plan line or a pre-existing surface alone is not enough evidence

lesson:build-a-role-top-down-from-its-fu.text: Build a role top-down from its full competency model (ISTQB-level), then layer project lessons; audit against the standard before calling it complete

lesson:dom-sampling-can-t-see-repaints-u.text: DOM sampling can't see repaints; use pixel frame-diff for visual stability, and get exact steps from recordings

lesson:environment-selection-in-internal.text: Environment selection in internal/stage tooling (env vars, profiles) is a deliberate design choice; an internal-only setup step is a note for the testers, not a product bug, unless docs or the owner say the profile should drive it

lesson:every-container-type-top-level-if.text: Every container type (top level, If branch, Else, Else-If, While body, nested block) has its OWN slash/action menu; inventory each one separately and compare it with the design, never infer one from another

lesson:expectations-arrive-mid-test-the-.text: Expectations arrive mid-test; the baseline must be refreshed from the thread every session; selection in one view must reflect in linked views

lesson:measure-what-the-screen-shows-whi.text: Measure what the screen shows while waiting, not only how long it takes; include first open after idle

lesson:most-false-alarms-come-from-the-p.text: Most false alarms come from the probe; confirm with a screenshot and a real user action before filing

lesson:on-shared-accounts-or-single-devi.text: On shared accounts or single-device envs, contention and slow resource release look like product bugs; check for other users' activity and wait out the release before attributing them to the product

lesson:re-running-a-child-of-a-container.text: Re-running a child of a container (loop, branch, module) re-runs the container; derive the expected result from the container's semantics at the moment of re-run (is the condition still true?), read the request payload, and ask the dev before filing

lesson:retest-with-the-original-steps-fi.text: Retest with the original steps first; artificial triggers need the user's go-ahead; not reproduced is not fixed

lesson:severity-follows-how-a-real-user-.text: Severity follows how a real user reaches the bug; a UI that blocks the action means the UI bug is fixed

lesson:synthetic-input-and-coordinate-cl.text: Synthetic input and coordinate clicks misrepresent rich inputs; confirm any odd input result with real keystrokes and target by role/label, never by screen coordinates

lesson:the-screenshot-must-show-the-exac.text: The screenshot must show the exact state the bug describes; quote only what is visible in it

lesson:what-is-hidden-by-default-is-stil.text: What is hidden by default is still product; inspect it

lesson:when-a-feature-ships-with-prs-rea.text: When a feature ships with PRs, read the diff for the gates on what you test (menus, flags, mode checks); a deliberate gate in code makes the gap a requirements question, not a regression

lesson:when-a-layout-defect-clipping-tru.text: When a layout defect (clipping, truncation, overlap) is found in one container, sweep every container of the same kind before filing, and list every place in the one bug
